## Quick Summary: 📝
Stargazer is a browser-based tool that transforms GitHub stargazers and contributors into visually appealing social media cards and animated MP4 loops. It focuses on client-side processing for privacy and real-time previews, allowing users to celebrate project milestones with custom designs.

## Key Takeaways: 💡

* ✅ Stargazer transforms GitHub milestones into cinematic animated videos and social cards.

* ✅ It offers 60fps in-browser video export using WebCodecs, eliminating the need for cloud rendering servers.

* ✅ The project is 100% client-side and private, ensuring your GitHub tokens never leave your browser.

* ✅ Developers benefit from live real-time previews and curated aesthetic options for stunning visuals.

* ✅ It provides an easy, secure, and engaging way to celebrate and share open-source achievements.


## Project Statistics: 📊
* ⭐ **Stars:** 15
* 🍴 **Forks:** 3
* ❗ **Open Issues:** 0


## Tech Stack: 💻
- ✅ TypeScript


Hey fellow developers! We all know that incredible feeling when your open-source project hits a significant milestone – whether it's 100, 1,000, or even a whopping 10,000 stars on GitHub. It's a moment worth celebrating, a testament to your hard work and the community's support! But let's be honest, taking a plain old screenshot of your repo header and sharing it on social media feels a bit... anticlimactic, doesn't it? It just doesn't capture the excitement and the journey. Well, prepare to be amazed, because I've found a game-changer that will transform how you celebrate these achievements: a fantastic open-source project called Stargazer! This project isn't just about showing off; it's about giving your milestones the grand, cinematic reveal they deserve. Stargazer takes your real stargazers and contributors and artfully transforms them into stunning, animated celebration videos and crisp 1600x900 social cards. Imagine sharing a dynamic, engaging video loop on X/Twitter, LinkedIn, or Discord instead of a static image – instantly more eye-catching, right? What makes Stargazer truly stand out is its ingenious approach to technology. Forget about complicated cloud rendering queues or external servers! Stargazer leverages the power of your browser with hardware-accelerated MP4 loops, all thanks to WebCodecs. This means you get beautiful, smooth 60fps video exports right in your browser. No waiting, no external dependencies, just pure, in-browser magic. This approach also makes it incredibly private and secure: your GitHub tokens never leave your browser's memory, ensuring zero tracking and zero databases involved. It's 100% client-side, giving you complete control and peace of mind. The experience of using Stargazer is incredibly fluid and intuitive. You get live, real-time previews as you customize your celebration. Want to tweak the repository, highlight specific contributors, or experiment with different themes? You'll see your changes instantly, allowing you to craft the perfect celebratory visual. And speaking of aesthetics, Stargazer offers a curated collection of visually stunning canvases. Think high-speed warp streaks, elegant orbital choreography, impressive laurel achievement grids, and captivating particle clusters. These aren't just generic templates; they're designed to make your project's achievement truly pop and feel premium. For us developers, the benefits are clear. Stargazer saves you a ton of time and effort. Instead of fiddling with video editing software or relying on third-party services, you can generate professional-looking celebration assets in minutes, directly from your browser. It elevates your project's visibility and professionalism when sharing milestones, attracting more attention and potentially more contributors. Plus, the privacy-first design is a huge win in today's digital landscape. It's a fantastic tool to add to your arsenal for making your open-source journey not just productive, but also visually spectacular. Seriously, go check out Stargazer – it's a brilliant way to give your hard-earned GitHub stars the spotlight they truly deserve!
